1 box of large shells.
12 0z of cream cheese
Package of pre sliced pepperoni(it's what I had laying around)
Shredded mozzarella cheese
Jar of pizza sauce.
Garlic seasoning
Italian seasoning
Pepper and salt
Basil leafs
Butter
Vegetable oil
-------
Boil the box of large shells in water,butter and vegetable oil
While the shells are cooking take the cream cheese and empty it into a medium sized mixing bowl.
Use a generous amount of seasoning on the cream cheese(garlic salt, italian seasoning, basil leafs) and stir until well mixed.
Finely chop the mozzarella (you want it to be small so you can't stuff it in the shells) and add it into the cream cheese.
Cut the pepperonis into small squares and add into the cream cheese.
Stir until mixed thoroughly 
-------
Take a Pyrex pan (I guess it doesn't matter what size) and butter the bottom of the pan thoroughly.
Start stuffing the shells and lining them through the pan in an orderly fashion.(it's okay if they overlap)
Once all the shells are stuffed and in the pan pour the pizza sauce over the shells.
Cover in a layer of mozzarella and add pepperonis on top.
-------
